title: Permission
description: A parameterized permission grant. Flat names cannot express scoped grants (paths, allowlists, budgets); every grant is a kind plus an optional scope object. Conventional scope keys per kind: fs.read/fs.write -> {paths: [..]}; net.egress -> {allow: [hosts]} or {unrestricted: true}; model.invoke -> {budget_usd_per_day, max_tokens_per_execution}; sandbox.create -> {backend, policy}; agent.create_ephemeral -> {max_concurrent}; memory.* and agent.delegate/agent.message typically need no scope. Enforcement status: LocalSandbox treats fs paths as virtual sandbox paths and enforces them for snapshot reads, supported file utilities, and output writes; model.invoke is required and its USD/token limits are checked before and after every call; max_concurrent is enforced; every scope participates in least-authority delegation checks. net.egress is unavailable in LocalSandbox and its allow/unrestricted scope is therefore recorded/subset-checked but not an OS network policy. sandbox backend and policy are RECORDED ONLY. USD checks depend on accurate configured pricing and are local guardrails, not provider billing quotas.

kind.description: Examples: fs.read, fs.write, net.egress, model.invoke, sandbox.create, tool.exec, agent.message, agent.delegate, agent.create_ephemeral, agent.propose_durable, agent.approve_proposals, skill.edit_shared, memory.read_own, memory.write_own, memory.read_shared, memory.write_shared, history.delete, external.side_effect
